body:
## Summary

- Drops the operator Quality console from the core: `app/(operator)/admin/quality`, the `EditionUi.OperatorConsole` slot, the operator page loaders and the cross-tenant `listQualityProjectSummaries`.
- The printable Quality report is always the member's report (console scope), and the calibration page always links it.
- The sync map marks the removed files `excluded`, and the READMEs no longer describe the slot.

Twin of ratel-ai/ratel-platform#116, which simplifies `/admin` (same branch: `feat/simplify-admin`). The Cloud edition no longer fills the slot, per decision d6-delete-all. Merge the ratel-platform PR first: an edition that still sets `OperatorConsole` would not type-check against this contract.

## Proof

Evidence is on the `proof/rp-21` branch ([README](https://github.com/ratel-ai/ratel/blob/proof/rp-21/proof/rp-21/README.md)). Commit pair: ratel `bc50fb77` and ratel-platform `21009916`.

- `/admin/quality` and a project's Quality page answer 404 for an elevated platform admin on a local Cloud build ([log](https://github.com/ratel-ai/ratel/blob/proof/rp-21/proof/rp-21/03-admin-quality-routes.log)):

  ![/admin/quality answers 404](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ratel-ai/ratel/proof/rp-21/proof/rp-21/03-admin-quality-404.png)

- Typecheck exits 0 for the open-source edition and for the Cloud edition ([log](https://github.com/ratel-ai/ratel/blob/proof/rp-21/proof/rp-21/02-typecheck.log)).
- The Quality headline and report-link tests pass (7), and the platform-sync tests pass (39) ([log](https://github.com/ratel-ai/ratel/blob/proof/rp-21/proof/rp-21/01-core-tests.log)).
